answer: I ran the Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit puts H on qubit 0, then a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, then measures both qubits. The job ID is 01a15f16-339e-7182-8211-fa27b1c8eb94 and the job completed. The counts are 00: 25, 01: 30, 10: 17, and 11: 28. The mock backend returns random results, so the counts are spread across all four outcomes and do not show Bell correlations. A real QPU should return mostly 00 and 11. The helper billed 1.0 second on the mock and estimated 0 credits. I submitted no real QPU jobs. I used the helper script iqm_run.py and the QASM file /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-4/bell.qasm.
